chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Muawiya ibn Wahb, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) married Ali to Fatima (peace be upon her) upon a cracked shield, and her bed was of sheep skin. They would make the wool to be underneath its side when sleeping.

key_terms.دِرْعٍ حُطَمِيَّةٍ: A cracked or slightly damaged shield

ai.seo_question: What was the dowry and bed of Imam Ali and Fatima (peace be upon them)?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded in Al-Kafi, underscores the asceticism (zuhd) of the Ahl al-Bayt by detailing the Prophet's direct arrangement of the marriage with a modest dowry of a cracked shield (dir' hatamiyya) and a simple sheepskin bed. It serves as a foundational narrative for Shia jurisprudence and ethics, illustrating that spiritual nobility is not contingent upon material wealth, a theme often linked to the verse of Purification (Ayat al-Tathir).
